title: Remove K Digits to Form Smallest Number

content.problemStatement:
Alice is organizing a coding competition where participants are given various
programming challenges to solve. One of the challenges she designed involves creating
an algorithm to find the smallest possible integer after removing a certain number of
digits from a given non-negative integer.
Given string num representing a non-negative integer num, and an integer k, return
the smallest possible integer after removing k digits from num.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Example demonstrating Use monotonic increasing stack to remove k digits greedily.
Example demonstrating Use monotonic increasing stack to remove k digits greedily.

solution.approach: Use monotonic increasing stack to remove k digits greedily.

editorial.overview: Push digits onto a stack, popping when stack top is larger than current digit while k > 0. Strip leading zeros.
